description: The 3D viewer window, and nothing else. It has no title bar, so it closes itself from its own right-click menu, moves itself on Shift-drag and goes full screen from that menu, and it listens for gesture zoom from the camera window. Saving a model goes through the app's own save_model_file command, which writes only .glb files into the JARVIS folder. No opener, no shell, no filesystem.
